method: ImageGen; one independent generation per character/attempt, same canonical outfit and pose

jobs.name: Ферн
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE isolated playable hero sprite, rear view, for a mobile RPG.
Primary reference image 1 is actual Knights of Pen & Paper 2 gameplay. Match its COARSE chunky pixel drawing, squat large-head proportions, simple dark pixel outline, compact hands and boots, hard flat color clusters, modest palette. Extend this SAME sprite language to a full-body standing back view. Logical pixel art on a 64x64 grid, enlarged cleanly by nearest neighbor: head approximately 18 pixels wide, body stout and short, whole person roughly 2.5 heads high. Keep individual squares visibly large and consistent. Character body should occupy about 42-48 logical pixels in height, weapon may extend to 58. No smooth anime illustration, no realistic anatomy, no modern high-resolution detailed pixel painting, no thin lanky silhouette.
Other images are CANON DESIGN references only. Translate their shapes faithfully to the coarse game pixels.
Composition: exactly ONE complete character, centered, feet at the same low baseline, seen directly from behind facing upscreen. Idle standing, both boots planted, only the back of the head visible; no face. Weapon wholly in frame with an uninterrupted physical shaft and visible grip. Truly transparent background, generous small transparent margin, no ground shadow.
This is a fidelity attempt at a LOCKED design. Do not invent costume variants, change hairstyle, swap accessories, add ornamentation, or mirror the specified equipment. No chairs, table, UI, scenery, numbers, labels or text.
Subject: FERN from the TV anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, standard travelling outfit.
LOCKED rear hairstyle: long straight deep-purple hair reaching lower back, upper side sections drawn smoothly into one HALF-UP gathering; the rest hangs as one long broad curtain. ONE silver-white horizontal butterfly-shaped filigree hair clasp centered on the back of her head at the gathering, as the anime close-up, represented as one broad HORIZONTAL OVAL silver backplate with raised butterfly-wing relief, about 8 pixels wide and 4 pixels high. It is an ornate OVAL metal clasp, not an isolated white bow. No bow, no ponytail, no twin tails, no braids. Hair and clasp remain the same across attempts.
LOCKED clothing: plain very dark charcoal long coat with simple sleeves over her white high-collared long dress; dark boots. No gold trim, extra jewelry or invented symbols. Long purple hair clearly overlays the dark coat.
LOCKED weapon: her actual old WOODEN STAFF from the references, held upright at her RIGHT side (viewer right in rear view), right hand visibly gripping the same continuous shaft. It has a long slim brown shaft, PURPLE cloth wrap, dull silver metal bands, an angular bent wooden neck and a broad blunt flattened wooden paddle-like top. Small hanging purple cord with tiny red tip near the upper wrap. Use the reference shape; it is NOT an orb staff, not a crescent, not a crystal wand. Keep staff outside hair silhouette and full top and bottom visible.
